title: Moroccan Kefta Tagine
description: A traditional Moroccan dish made with spiced kefta meatballs and vegetables cooked in a flavorful tagine.
instructions: Heat oil in the tagine over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add sliced carrots and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add kefta meatballs and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add Moroccan spices and stir to combine.
Cover the tagine and transfer to the oven. Cook at 180°C (360°F) for 20-25 minutes or until the meatballs are cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
